# Flight Cancellation Refund – Aapke Haq Aur Kya Karein

## 1. Aapka Legal Right (Kanoon Kya Kehta Hai)

### DGCA Guidelines (Sabse Important)

DGCA ne circular jara hai ki flight cancel hone par **passenger ko choice milti hai**:

| Option | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| ✅ Full Refund | Ticket price + taxes wapas |
| ✅ Rebooking | Agli flight par free |
| ✅ Credit Note | Sirf agar aap khud maanoge |

> **Point:** Airline aapko **force nahi kar sakti** credit note lene par. Aapko **refund ka right** hai.

### Consumer Protection Act, 2019

- **Section 2(46)** – "Unfair Trade Practice" – Airline ka sirf credit note dena aur refund se inkaar karna unfair practice hai.
- **Section 2(11)** – "Service" – Flight service bhi service hai, isliye Consumer Act apply hota hai.
- **Section 40** – Consumer Commission refund, compensation, aur interest order de sakti hai.

---

## 2. Step-by-Step Action Plan

### Step 1: Written Complaint to Airline (Aaj hi karein)

Email + Registered Post dono se bhejein. Template:

```
Subject: Refund Demand – PNR: [XXXXXX] – Flight: [No.] – Date: [Date]

Dear Sir/Madam,

My flight [Flight No.] dated [Date] was cancelled by your airline. 
I paid ₹12,000 for PNR [XXXXXX]. 

As per DGCA guidelines, I am entitled to a full refund of the ticket 
price. I do NOT accept a credit note/voucher.

I demand a full refund of ₹12,000 to my original mode of payment 
within 7 days.

Please note that failure to comply will compel me to approach the 
DGCA Grievance Redressal Cell and the Consumer Forum.

Regards,
[Name, Phone, Email]
```

**Deadline dein: 7 din.**

---

### Step 2: DGCA Grievance Portal (7 din baad)

Agar airline ne 7 din mein reply nahi kiya ya refund nahi aaya:

🔗 **bpgrievance.dgca.gov.in**

- Yahan complaint file karein
- Airline ko **7 din** mein respond karna hota hai
- DGCA airline par pressure daalta hai – zyada tar cases yahi solve ho jaate hain

---

### Step 3: Consumer Forum Complaint (Agar DGCA se bhi nahi hua)

| Forum | Jurisdiction |
|-------|-------------|
| District Consumer Commission | Claim ₹1 lakh – ₹50 lakh |
| State Consumer Commission | ₹50 lakh – ₹2 crore |
| National Consumer Commission | ₹2 crore se upar |

**Aapka claim ₹12,000 hai → District Consumer Commission** mein file karein.

#### Kya claim kar sakte hain:

| Item | Amount |
|------|--------|
| Refund | ₹12,000 |
| Interest (refund delay par) | ~12-18% p.a. (court discretion) |
| Compensation (mental agony, harassment) | ₹5,000 – ₹25,000 (case by case) |
| Cost of complaint | ₹1,000 – ₹5,000 |

#### Kya documents chahiye:
- Ticket / PNR confirmation
- Payment proof (bank statement / UTR)
- Cancellation email/SMS
- Complaints ki copies (email, chat screenshots)
- DGCA complaint acknowledgment

#### Time Limit:
- **2 saal** tak file kar sakte hain (cause of action se)
- Lekin jaldi karein – evidence fresh rahega

---

## 3. Case Law (Reference ke liye)

| Case | Holding |
|------|---------|
| **Indian Airlines v. Union of India** | Airline ki duty hai passenger ko refund dena |
| **Various Consumer Commission orders** | Credit note force karna = deficiency in service + unfair practice |
| **Section 2(46) CPA 2019** | Unfair practice mein "restricting consumer's choice" included hai |

> Zyada tar consumer courts mein airlines ko **refund + interest + compensation** dena padta hai jab wo credit note force karti hain.

---

## 4. Quick Summary (TL;DR)

```
Aaj:        Written complaint (email + registered post)
7 din baad: DGCA portal par complaint
15-30 din:  Consumer Forum mein complaint file karein
```

---

## 5. Extra Tips

- **Credit note accept mat karein** – agar accept kar liya toh refund ka right khatam ho jata hai
- **Sab kuch written mein rakhein** – phone calls ka record nahi hota
- **Bank se "chargeback" bhi try kar sakte hain** – agar credit card se payment hua tha toh bank se dispute raise karein (30 din ke andar)
- **Legal aid** – agar khud nahi kar pa rahe toh local Bar Association ya NALSA se free legal aid le sakte hain

---

Kya aap chahte hain ki main aapke liye **Consumer Forum complaint ka draft** bhi bana doon? Bataiye airline ka naam, flight number, date, aur payment mode – main ready draft de dunga.
